neutral.EN: He's down. You alright?
neutral.TL: Bagsak na siya. Ayos ka?

neutral.EN: Got the shooter. Did you take any hits?
neutral.TL: Naitumba ang bumaril. Tinamaan ka ba?

neutral.EN: He's dead. Are you hurt anywhere?
neutral.TL: Patay na siya. May masakit ba sa'yo?

neutral.EN: Took him down. Check yourself over.
neutral.TL: Ibinagsak ko na. Tignan mo ang katawan mo.

neutral.EN: Threat is eliminated. You safe?
neutral.TL: Wala na ang banta. Ligtas ka ba?

neutral.EN: I got him off you. Breathe.
neutral.TL: Nailayo ko sa'yo. Huminga ka.

neutral.EN: He's not getting back up. You good?
neutral.TL: Hindi na siya babangon. Ayos ka lang?

neutral.EN: Downed the gunman. Stay with me.
neutral.TL: Bagsak ang may baril. Sumabay ka sa akin.

neutral.EN: It's okay, I got him. Check your wounds.
neutral.TL: Ayos lang, nakuha ko na siya. Tignan ang mga sugat mo.

neutral.EN: Shooter's dead. We're still standing.
neutral.TL: Patay na ang bumaril. Nakatayo pa rin tayo.

neutral.EN: It's over. Stay close to me.
neutral.TL: Tapos na. Dumikit ka sa akin.

neutral.EN: He's dead. Keep tight on my shoulder.
neutral.TL: Patay na siya. Dumikit ka lang sa balikat ko.

neutral.EN: Fight's ending. Don't wander off.
neutral.TL: Pahupa na ang laban. Huwag kang lalayo.

neutral.EN: He won't hurt us now. Stay near.
neutral.TL: Hindi na niya tayo masasaktan. Manatili sa malapit.

neutral.EN: Target down. Stick close while we clear.
neutral.TL: Bagsak ang target. Dumikit habang naglilinis tayo.

neutral.EN: Got him. Stay behind cover with me.
neutral.TL: Nakuha ko na. Dito ka sa kublihan kasama ko.

neutral.EN: It's handled. We stick together.
neutral.TL: Naasikaso na. Magsama tayo.

neutral.EN: Threat dropped. Keep close until it's quiet.
neutral.TL: Bagsak ang banta. Dumikit hanggang tumahimik.

neutral.EN: He's finished. I've got your back.
neutral.TL: Tapos na siya. Hawak ko ang likod mo.

neutral.EN: Down. Don't leave my side.
neutral.TL: Bagsak. Huwag kang aalis sa tabi ko.

neutral.EN: He's dead. Check yourself for hits.
neutral.TL: Patay na siya. Tingnan mo kung tinamaan ka.

neutral.EN: Threat cleared. Inspect your gear and clothes.
neutral.TL: Malinis ang banta. Tignan ang gamit at damit mo.

neutral.EN: He's gone. Any blood on you?
neutral.TL: Wala na siya. May dugo ba sa'yo?

neutral.EN: Got him down. Tell me if you're bleeding.
neutral.TL: Ibinagsak ko na. Sabihin mo agad kung dumurugo ka.

neutral.EN: Shooter is dead. Check each other over.
neutral.TL: Patay na ang bumaril. Magtinginan tayo kung may tama.

neutral.EN: Target down. Do a quick self-check.
neutral.TL: Bagsak ang target. Mag-check ka agad sa sarili mo.

neutral.EN: He's finished. Make sure you weren't grazed.
neutral.TL: Tapos na siya. Siguraduhing hindi ka nadaplisan.

neutral.EN: Downed. Patch up if you need to.
neutral.TL: Bagsak. Magbenda ka kung kailangan.

neutral.EN: Confirmed kill. Are all your limbs okay?
neutral.TL: Kumpirmadong patay. Ayos ba lahat ng braso at binti mo?

neutral.EN: He's on the ground. Check your condition.
neutral.TL: Nasa lupa na siya. Tignan ang kondisyon mo.
